items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine and Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine Interview, 1960-05-23
items.q: I think, his wife is married to Bud Lai Canna.

ctx.x: Happy Rap was the man's name.
His wife was fired to Bud Lai Canna. He come to me and I can't, I think, his wife is married to Bud Lai Canna.

One of the old men anyhow died. To Bud Lai Canna. Yeah, Bud, you know Bud, he said not to Rapp at all. Well, he said you can get over this stuff, I know you can. He's here. His picture, we got his picture here, Bud.
